title: hydrocotyle bonariensis var. tribotrys
intro: Hydrocotyle bonariensis var. tribotrys, commonly known as American pennywort, is a species of flowering plant in the family Araliaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, such as inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of American pennywort include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including wound healing, immune system modulation, and antiviral activity. The bioactive constituents of American pennywort include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
